text:
jun: kicking off a dry-run for the thin-client header routing change. planning to flip feature-flag in the quiet window (23:00 UTC). need confirmation on pins: api -> v1.4.2, runtime -> kernel-b14 (questionable), console -> console-3.9.0, router -> header-swap branch. who is green for this?

deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run for 2025-07-20T23:00:00Z (window 15m). run id: db-78321. tagging teams. :robot_face:

maya: runtime note — kernel-b14 includes a perf tweak that changes KV cache TTL semantics. for short sequences it can add ~10-30ms p95. i'd recommend pinning runtime to kernel-b13 for the dry-run, keep b14 for canary. also ensure quantization plan stays q4.

ton y: router: header-swap branch is backward-compatible but some thin clients don't send X-NewHeader. i can add a guard that falls back to old route if header missing. will add guard and run quick curl test.

tony: quick test:
```
curl -v -H "X-NewHeader: test" https://router.staging/route
```

sara: console: console-3.9.0 reads X-NewHeader to surface per-route latency. if header absent we'll see missing route tiles + noisy alerts. request: add a telemetry shim so missing headers show as "legacy" instead of dropping tiles.

jun: summary so far — runtime pinned to kernel-b13 for dry-run, router will add fallback guard, console will add shim. metrics to watch: p95 latency, route-error-rate, console-missing-header. rollback criteria? proposals?

maya: rollback criteria suggestion: revert if p95 latency increases >25% vs baseline OR route error-rate spike >1% sustained for 5m. also, set KV eviction threshold to 30s during dry-run to avoid cache churn.

tony: guard pushed to staging. staging curl returns 200 with and without header. Will promote guard in the quiet window.

deploy-bot: deploy wave db-78321 triggered: api:v1.4.2@sha=abc123, runtime:kernel-b13@sha=def456, router:guard/headerswap@sha=ghj789, console:console-3.9.0-shim@sha=klm012. All jobs queued.

ops-bot: quiet window lock set by @jun for 15m starting 2025-07-20T23:00:00Z — contact list: jun, maya, tony, sara.

jun: final checklist: 1) release notes updated; 2) monitoring alerts created for p95, err-rate, and missing-header metric; 3) runtime pinned to kernel-b13 for dry-run; 4) router guard and console shim deployed in window; 5) rollback plan: revert runtime & router shas + unpin API. If thresholds hit, call the pager and hit rollback. phone emoji.

maya: LGTM — i'll watch runtime telemetry and be ready to revert.

tony: LGTM — i'll watch route funnels and confirm guard behaves in prod.

sara: LGTM — will watch dashboards and mute non-actionable alerts.

jun: thanks everyone — starting the dry-run on schedule. will post a short postmortem if anything notable. :white_check_mark:
